project.name: osgi/domains/bbox/bbox-contract
project.description: The bbox domain's contract: its flat reservation vocabulary (BboxReservationRequest / BboxRowOutcome / BboxAction) AND the consumer-side BboxReconciler service interface (reconcile a set of desired DHCP reservations against the router, dry-run or apply). type=contract — installed and wired bundle-to-bundle, NOT a seam (the host never reconciles; the edge provides the reconciler @Component, the scion resolves it, both in-container). It carries no @Component and does not Require the SCR extender, so a scion that needs only BboxReconciler imports this, not bbox-core (whose BlueprintRowEnumerator is domain logic). Splits the former bbox-core, which fused contract + logic.
